description: F0-D T9 exact minimum image (facet.analysis.geometry.mic_vector / web/js/core/geometry.js micVector), ledger L-F0-20 and section 5.4: skewed and slab cells, all three axes and a/b only, half cell vectors (the tie rule) and random vectors; partial periodicity; the error messages. Expected vectors and images were computed once, during development, by exhaustive enumeration (every translation with |g_k + n_k| <= |v| / h_k, the shortest length, ties within 1e-8 Å broken by the smallest floor(1e6 (g + n) + 0.5)), not by the code under test. Images compare exactly, vectors within 1e-12 Å. Ops: tests/ops/f0d_geometry.py and tests/js/ops/f0d_geometry.mjs.
